articles.title_en: Persistent and transitory inflation in the euro area: Insights from global and domestic shocks
articles.title_cn: 欧元区的持久性与暂时性通胀：来自全球与国内冲击的洞见
articles.abstract_en: This paper investigates the post-COVID inflation surge in the euro area, combining three features: decomposition of long-term trends and business-cycle dynamics—such as potential GDP, trend inflation, output-gap, and inflation-gap; time-varying volatility and fat-tailed distributions to accommodate extreme observations; and structural shock identification, distinguishing shocks by their persistence (permanent-vs.-transitory) and domain (global-vs.-domestic, demand-vs.-supply, or energy-specific). Unlike the existing literature, findings show that domestic supply shocks feed into the persistent component of euro area inflation, raising trend inflation to 3% by 2022. Demand shocks—domestic and global—manifest in the transitory component (inflation gap), explaining 85% of the post-COVID inflation surge.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究新冠疫情后欧元区的通胀飙升，结合三个特征：长期趋势与商业周期动态的分解——如潜在GDP、趋势通胀、产出缺口和通胀缺口；时变波动率和厚尾分布以容纳极端观测值；以及结构冲击识别，按持续性（永久性与暂时性）和领域（全球与国内、需求与供给、或能源特定）区分冲击。与现有文献不同，研究结果表明，国内供给冲击渗入欧元区通胀的持久成分，将趋势通胀提高2022至3%。需求冲击——国内和全球——体现在暂时成分（通胀缺口）中，解释了新冠疫情后通胀飙升的85%。

articles.title_en: High frequency measurement of consumer price inflation using scanner data
articles.title_cn: 使用扫描数据高频测度消费者价格通胀
articles.abstract_en: Consumer price inflation is conventionally measured at a monthly or quarterly frequency. However, the increased availability of electronic point-of-sale data (scanner data) raises the possibility of constructing indexes at higher frequencies, such as weekly. This is likely to benefit many users, such as central banks, who closely follow consumer price trends. A key challenge in building high frequency weekly price indexes is intertemporal substitution. The dependence of current expenditures on past prices can introduce bias into the index. The paper proposes a novel solution to address this problem. We construct low frequency cost-of-living comparisons between two spans of weeks. Then show how to identify high-frequency weekly price changes from these low frequency multi-week price comparisons. Our approach to constructing weekly indexes is illustrated using a large US scanner data set from 2006 to 2020. We find modest increases in the variability of weekly compared with monthly indexes. Our results highlight that high frequency weekly indexes can be readily constructed in practice and that they are likely to provide new insights to policymakers.
articles.abstract_cn: 消费者价格通胀通常按月或按季度频率测度。然而，电子销售点数据（扫描数据）可得性的提高，使得构建更高频率（如周度）指数的可能性增加。这可能使许多使用者受益，例如密切关注消费者价格趋势的中央银行。构建高频周度价格指数的一个关键挑战是跨期替代。当前支出对过去价格的依赖可能给指数带来偏误。本文提出一种新的解决方案来应对这一问题。我们构建两个周区间之间的低频生活成本比较。然后展示如何从这些低频多周价格比较中识别高频周度价格变化。我们使用2006至2020期间的一个大型美国扫描数据集来说明构建周度指数的方法。我们发现，与月度指数相比，周度指数的变异性有适度增加。我们的结果强调，高频周度指数在实践中可以 readily 构建，并且很可能为政策制定者提供新的洞见。

articles.title_en: On the role of uncertainty in timing environmental policies
articles.title_cn: 论不确定性在环境政策时机中的作用
articles.abstract_en: We develop a real options framework for the optimal timing of climate policy when both economic cost and stocks of environmental pollutants evolve stochastically and are correlated. By modelling environmental damage as a mean-reverting pollution stock jointly driven with uncertain economic losses, we extend the single-uncertainty specifications of Pindyck (2000) and the uncorrelated two-dimensional specification of Pindyck (2002). The resulting policy-adoption problem is formulated as a two-dimensional variational inequality (VI). We derive the post-policy value function in closed form and obtain an analytical necessary-condition curve that provides a sub-optimal stopping rule. Consistent with the correction of the proposed closed-form pre-policy stopping solutions by Balikcioglu et al. (2011), we compute the pre-policy value function and the globally optimal boundary numerically from the contact set of the VI.Across the configurations considered, the optimal stopping boundary is decreasing and predominantly convex in the pollution stock. The effect of uncertainty on policy timing is not uniform. In the main sensitivity exercise, positive correlation causes greater pollution-stock volatility to lower the boundary and accelerate adoption, whereas greater economic-cost volatility raises the boundary, with a smaller additional increase at higher volatility levels. Under negative correlation, greater volatility in either state variable raises the boundary and delays adoption. Under the nested single-uncertainty and uncorrelated zero-decay benchmark specifications (Pindyck, 2000, 2002), our numerical solutions produce the conventional uncertainty-delay ordering, qualitatively consistent with the corrected numerical boundaries reported by Balikcioglu et al. (2011). In a positively correlated extension of the uncorrelated two-dimensional benchmark, however, greater economic-cost volatility lowers the boundary. Policy timing therefore depends on the full joint-risk specification and the broader parameter configuration, rather than on volatility or correlation considered alone.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个实物期权框架，用于确定气候政策的最优时机，其中经济成本和环境污染物存量均随机演化且相互相关。通过将环境损害建模为与不确定经济损失共同驱动的均值回归污染存量，我们扩展了Pindyck（2000）的单一不确定性设定以及Pindyck（2002）的不相关二维设定。由此得到的政策采纳问题被表述为二维变分不等式（VI）。我们以闭式形式推导出政策后价值函数，并获得一条解析必要条件曲线，该曲线提供了一个次优停止规则。与Balikcioglu等（2011）对 proposed closed-form pre-policy stopping solutions 的修正相一致，我们从VI的接触集数值计算政策前价值函数和全局最优边界。在所考虑的配置中，最优停止边界随污染存量递减且主要呈凸性。不确定性对政策时机的影响并不一致。在主要敏感性分析中，正相关导致更大的污染存量波动性降低边界并加速采纳，而更大的经济成本波动性则提高边界，且在更高波动性水平下额外增幅较小。在负相关下，任一状态变量的更大波动性都会提高边界并延迟采纳。在嵌套的单一不确定性和不相关零衰减基准设定（Pindyck，2000，2002）下，我们的数值解产生了传统的“不确定性—延迟”排序，在定性上与Balikcioglu等（2011）报告的修正数值边界一致。然而，在不相关二维基准的正相关扩展中，更大的经济成本波动性会降低边界。因此，政策时机取决于完整的联合风险设定和更广泛的参数配置，而非仅取决于波动性或相关性。

articles.title_cn: 支撑位、阻力位与技术交易
articles.abstract_en: I use coarse Bayesian updating to explain asset price levels at which the price will tend to stop and reverse. With limited attention, traders discretize the space of expected prices. I show that it is ex ante optimal for them to select an equally-spaced price grid to minimize ex post trading errors. Support and resistance levels appear in the endogenous price distribution because, as prices near a support (resistance) level, coarse Bayesians believe that the asset is underpriced (overpriced), leading to purchases (sales) and ensuing upward (downward) pressure on prices. This phenomenon is robust to the presence of rational arbitrageurs.
articles.abstract_cn: 我使用粗粒度贝叶斯更新来解释价格倾向于停止并反转的资产价格水平。在有限注意力下，交易者将预期价格空间离散化。我证明，事前选择等间距价格网格以最小化事后交易误差是最优的。支撑位和阻力位出现在内生价格分布中，因为当价格接近支撑（阻力）位时，粗粒度贝叶斯主义者认为资产被低估（高估），从而导致买入（卖出）以及随之而来的价格上行（下行）压力。这一现象在理性套利者存在时依然稳健。

articles.title_en: I think you think I think: Hierarchical belief learning and endogenous volatility dynamics
articles.title_cn: 我认为你认为我认为：层级信念学习与内生波动率动态
articles.abstract_en: This paper develops a hierarchical belief learning model that endogenizes recursive expectation formation in financial markets. Agents form multi-level beliefs about future prices and about how other market participants forecast them, creating a finite, alternating cognitive hierarchy that links the depth and composition of recursive cross-type inference to aggregate price dynamics. The deterministic analysis shows that faster price adjustment or stronger recursive cross-type feedback can induce transitions from local stability to persistent oscillations and bounded irregular fluctuations. The stochastic extension demonstrates that small random shocks interacting with hierarchical feedback can generate volatility clustering, heavy tails, and persistent dependence in volatility proxies. Analytical characterization through local stability conditions, the Jacobian spectrum, and Lyapunov-based numerical evidence confirms that instability emerges endogenously from belief feedback rather than from exogenous disturbances. Empirical estimation using daily S&P 500 returns verifies that the model reproduces the principal stylized facts of financial markets and achieves the strongest overall joint fit in the benchmark set while remaining highly competitive in out-of-sample forecasting relative to econometric, behavioral, and machine-learning alternatives.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文构建了一个层级信念学习模型，将金融市场中的递归预期形成内生化。代理人形成关于未来价格以及关于其他市场参与者如何预测它们的多层信念，从而形成一个有限的、交替的认知层级，将递归跨类型推断的深度与构成同总体价格动态联系起来。确定性分析表明，更快的价格调整或更强的递归跨类型反馈可以引致从局部稳定性向持续振荡和有界不规则波动的转变。随机扩展证明，小的随机冲击与层级反馈相互作用可以产生波动率聚集、厚尾以及波动率代理变量中的持续依赖。通过局部稳定性条件、雅可比谱和基于李雅普诺夫的数值证据进行的解析刻画确认，不稳定性内生地源于信念反馈，而非外生扰动。使用日度S&P 500收益率进行的经验估计验证，该模型再现了金融市场的主要典型事实，并在基准集合中实现了最强的总体联合拟合，同时在样本外预测方面相对于计量经济学、行为学和机器学习替代方法仍具有高度竞争力。

articles.title_en: What can we gain from pooling VAR and local projection impulse response functions?
articles.title_cn: 将VAR和局部投影脉冲响应函数合并能给我们带来什么？
articles.abstract_en: I show that pooling Vector Autoregression (VAR) and Local Projection (LP) impulse response functions (IRFs) may address the bias-variance trade-off in IRF estimation. I also propose a sequence-of-block bootstrap method, designed to construct confidence intervals for the pooled IRFs. I document three main findings: (i) Monte Carlo exercises suggest that the pooled estimator generally yields lower root mean squared error than both VAR and LP at short and medium horizons. (ii) Using the sequence-of-block bootstrap, inference based on the pooled estimator delivers coverage rates that are slightly lower than those under LP and more accurate than those based on VAR, while producing substantially shorter average interval lengths than LP. (iii) The pooling approach combined with the sequence-of-block bootstrap produces sensible results in an empirical application to monetary policy.
articles.abstract_cn: 我表明，将向量自回归（VAR）和局部投影（LP）脉冲响应函数（IRFs）合并可能解决IRF估计中的偏差-方差权衡问题。我还提出了一种分块序列自助法，旨在为合并后的IRFs构建置信区间。我记录了三个主要发现：（i）蒙特卡洛练习表明，在短期和中期horizon上，合并估计量通常比VAR和LP产生更低的均方根误差。（ii）使用分块序列自助法，基于合并估计量的推断提供的覆盖率略低于LP下的覆盖率，但比基于VAR的覆盖率更准确，同时产生的平均区间长度显著短于LP。（iii）将合并方法与分块序列自助法结合，在货币政策的一个实证应用中产生了合理的结果。

articles.title_en: Forecasting the price of carbon with macroeconomic and financial variables
articles.title_cn: 用宏观经济和金融变量预测碳价格
articles.abstract_en: We tackle the issue of producing point, sign, and density forecasts for the monthly real price of carbon in the European Union Emissions Trading System (EU ETS). We show that Bayesian Vector Autoregressive (BVAR) models augmented with factors based on macroeconomic and financial variables yield improvements in point and density forecasting performance, with the largest point-forecast gains emerging at intermediate and longer horizons. In particular, the one-factor BVAR model provides lowest values at six and nine months ahead, while the baseline BVAR performs best at the one-year horizon. By contrast, a large BVAR including all predictors individually does not improve point forecast accuracy, supporting the use of parsimonious model specifications. Simple forecast pooling delivers modest gains from medium horizons onward, but does not mitigate the time variation in relative forecast performance. We also provide a qualitative comparison of model-based forecasts with survey expectations and forecasts released by data providers, which further highlights that relative forecast performance varies over time. Moreover, we consider verified emissions and show that stochastic volatility improves point forecasts, with reductions of about 6.5–7.1% at the one-year horizon. Lastly, we use model-based forecasts to construct market monitoring tools that track demand and price pressure in the EU ETS.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们处理为欧盟排放交易体系（EU ETS）中月度实际碳价格生成点预测、符号预测和密度预测的问题。我们表明，基于宏观经济和金融变量的因子增广的贝叶斯向量自回归（BVAR）模型在点预测和密度预测性能上有所改善，最大的点预测收益出现在中期和较长预测期。具体而言，单因子BVAR模型在提前六个月和九个月时给出最低值，而基准BVAR在一年期表现最佳。相比之下，包含所有预测变量的大型BVAR并未提高点预测精度，这支持使用简约模型设定。简单预测组合从中期起带来适度收益，但并未缓解相对预测表现的时间变化。我们还对基于模型的预测与调查预期及数据提供者发布的预测进行了定性比较，进一步凸显相对预测表现随时间变化。此外，我们考虑核证排放量，并表明随机波动率改善点预测，在一年期约降低6.5-7.1%。最后，我们使用基于模型的预测构建市场监测工具，以跟踪EU ETS中的需求和价格压力。

articles.title_en: Early Social Security claiming and slow asset decumulation: experimental evidence
articles.title_cn: 提前申领社会保障与缓慢资产消耗：实验证据
articles.abstract_en: Retirement behavior in the U.S. exhibits two well-documented patterns: most individuals claim Social Security benefits early, before reaching their full retirement age, and retirees decumulate their assets more slowly than predicted by standard life-cycle models. This paper provides experimental evidence that these patterns emerge even in a controlled individual decision-making environment where early claiming and slow decumulation are not optimal. In a baseline treatment calibrated to current U.S. Social Security rules, participants display both early claiming and slower-than-optimal asset decumulation. Replacing larger annuities with lump-sum incentives in two alternative treatments, as has been proposed in the U.S. Congress, accelerates asset decumulation but does not lead to delayed claiming. These findings generalize from a convenience student sample to an older sample aged 45-55 and broadly resemble the observed behavior of similarly situated respondents in the Health and Retirement Study. We show that a wealth-preservation motive can jointly generate early claiming and slow asset decumulation, consistent with the experimental evidence.
articles.abstract_cn: 美国退休行为呈现出两个有充分文献记载的模式：大多数个体在达到完全退休年龄之前提前申领社会保障福利，并且退休人员消耗资产的速度慢于标准生命周期模型的预测。本文提供实验证据表明，即使在受控的个体决策环境中——其中提前申领和缓慢资产消耗并非最优——这些模式也会出现。在根据当前美国社会保障规则校准的基线处理中，参与者同时表现出提前申领和慢于最优的资产消耗。在两种替代处理中，用一次性给付激励替代较大额年金（正如美国国会所提议的），会加速资产消耗，但不会导致延迟申领。这些发现从便利学生样本推广到年龄为45-55的较年长样本，并与健康与退休研究中处境相似的受访者的观察行为大体相似。我们表明，财富保全动机可以共同产生提前申领和缓慢资产消耗，这与实验证据一致。

articles.title_en: Optimal size and composition of government spending in small open economies
articles.title_cn: 小型开放经济中政府支出的最优规模与构成
articles.abstract_en: We study optimal fiscal policy in a small open economy within a currency union subject to downward nominal wage rigidity. Government spending is divided between public consumption and productive public investment, with investment accumulating into public capital subject to time-to-build. We characterize the Ramsey allocation when the policymaker jointly chooses consumption taxes, public consumption, and public investment. Fiscal instruments operate through distinct but complementary margins: consumption taxes mitigate unemployment distortions when wage rigidity binds, while spending composition provides an additional intertemporal stabilization margin. In particular, state contingent public investment reallocates non-tradable resources over time, smoothing private consumption and attenuating relative price fluctuations with limited contemporaneous distortions. Calibrating the model to France, we find that coordinated fiscal policy substantially reduces unemployment risk and generates measurable welfare gains relative to regimes that rely only on taxes or keep government spending composition fixed. The results are robust across country re-calibrations for Greece, Italy, and Spain, as well as in extensions with government production, alternative time-to-build horizons, public capital adjustment costs, preference parameters, wage rigidity, and bond holding costs.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究在存在向下名义工资刚性的货币联盟内，小型开放经济中的最优财政政策。政府支出分为公共消费和生产性公共投资，投资在存在建设时滞的条件下积累为公共资本。我们刻画了政策制定者联合选择消费税、公共消费和公共投资时的拉姆齐配置。财政工具通过不同但互补的边际发挥作用：当工资刚性约束生效时，消费税缓解失业扭曲，而支出构成提供了额外的跨期稳定边际。特别地，状态依存的公共投资在时间上重新配置非贸易资源，平滑私人消费并在当期扭曲有限的情况下减弱相对价格波动。将模型校准至法国，我们发现，相对于仅依赖税收或保持政府支出构成不变的制度，协调的财政政策大幅降低了失业风险并产生了可衡量的福利收益。结果在针对希腊、意大利和西班牙的国别重新校准中，以及在包含政府生产、替代性建设时滞期限、公共资本调整成本、偏好参数、工资刚性和债券持有成本的扩展中均保持稳健。

articles.title_en: Dynamic effects of population aging on natural interest rates
articles.title_cn: 人口老龄化对自然利率的动态效应
articles.abstract_en: Declining fertility and rising longevity are accelerating population aging worldwide. We study their effects on interest rates using a quantitative life-cycle model that explicitly accounts for the long lag between birth and labor-market entry, and features Barro-Becker parental preference, endogenous human capital accumulation, and a public pension system. Reducing fertility raises the interest rate during a sustained transition, as agents increase consumption in anticipation of future labor shortages and wage growth, before converging to a lower steady state. Increasing longevity instead monotonically reduces the interest rate by raising precautionary savings. These divergent dynamics are robust to variations in the pension system, human capital inputs, and child-related allocations. A historical decomposition further shows that fertility shocks have been the dominant demographic driver of U.S. interest rate fluctuations since 1960. These findings challenge the view that aging uniformly lowers interest rates and highlight the distinct implications of fertility- and longevity-driven aging.
articles.abstract_cn: 生育率下降和寿命延长正在全球范围内加速人口老龄化。我们使用一个量化生命周期模型研究它们对利率的影响，该模型明确考虑了出生与进入劳动力市场之间的长滞后，并具有Barro-Becker父母偏好、内生人力资本积累和公共养老金制度。降低生育率会在持续转型期间提高利率，因为代理人预期未来劳动力短缺和工资增长而增加消费，随后收敛至较低的稳态。相反，延长寿命通过提高预防性储蓄单调地降低利率。这些不同的动态对养老金制度、人力资本投入和与子女相关的分配的变化是稳健的。历史分解进一步表明，自1960以来，生育率冲击一直是美国利率波动的主要人口驱动因素。这些发现挑战了老龄化统一降低利率的观点，并凸显了生育率驱动和寿命驱动老龄化的不同含义。

excluded_items.title_en: Introduction to the special issue honoring Michel Juillard’s contribution to macroeconomics
